description: This file defines a scraper class 'DagelijkseKost' for extracting recipe instructions from a specific website, including functions for JSON parsing, instruction extraction, and string similarity measurement.

classes.name: DagelijkseKost
classes.description: A scraper class inheriting from AbstractScraper, tailored for the 'dagelijksekost.vrt.be' website, with methods to retrieve canonical URL and instructions.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the scraper.

methods.name: canonical_url
methods.description: Returns the canonical URL of the recipe, using '@id' if available and valid.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe instructions by parsing embedded JSON data and comparing instruction texts.
